title: Explosion/Fire
content: Last night I was in the mall. It was way busier than I'm used to. However, I saw something explode and catch fire. When I moved perspective to where my body was across the mall there was chaos. People running, light almost translucent smoke in the distance, but I could smell the smoke. People ran away and I ran towards it. I got there and there was no more fire or smoke but things didn't make sense. People were missing things not where they were supposed to be. I don't know it just isn't sitting right with me.
